name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 384 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 384 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Manipur seized AK-series rifles, grenades, bullet-proof gear and disrupted a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp while reviewing border fencing and joint grids, and the Assam Rifles DG inspected the work along the India-Myanmar border. In South Kashmir the DGP and GOC of 15 Corps reviewed ongoing security operations, conducted a joint anti-fidayeen mock drill in Bandipora, and a JCO was found dead, prompting a probe. A six-year-old boy was killed after a dumper struck him in South Kashmir and a truck collision killed its driver in Ramban, while two people were buried alive by a sand mound in Baramulla. The Kuki-Zo Council warned of stronger political measures, including withdrawing MLAs, and the Naga council backed a mega rally in Manipur calling for the SoO pact to be scrapped. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Manipur konfiskerte AK-serierrifler, granater, skuddsikre utstyr og avbrøt en Kuki-Zo-opprørsleir mens de gjennomgikk grensegjerder og felles nett, og Assam Rifles-direktøren inspiserte arbeidet langs India-Myanmar-grensen. I Sør-Kashmir gjennomgikk DGP og GOC for 15 korps pågående sikkerhetsoperasjoner, gjennomførte en felles anti-fidayeen-øvelsesøvelse i Bandipora, og en JCO ble funnet død, noe som førte til en etterforskning. En six-year-old gutt ble drept etter at en dumper traff ham i Sør-Kashmir, og en lastebilkollisjon drepte sjåføren i Ramban, mens to personer ble begravd levende av en sandhaug i Baramulla. Kuki-Zo-rådet advarte om strengere politiske tiltak, inkludert å trekke tilbake MLA-er, og Naga-rådet støttet en megademonstrasjon i Manipur som krevde at SoO-avtalen skal avskaffes. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
